basic_info.description: Victorian 3-unit in the heart of the Upper Haight with extensive updates and a vacant, move-in-ready top-floor flat. 943-945 Haight Street features a full-floor 3BD/2BA unit with expansive city views, renovated kitchen with designer finishes, two updated baths, a sunroom, and direct access to a private deck and shared garden with fruit trees, herbs, and berries. The middle unit is a spacious 1BD/1BA + sunroom (tenant-occupied at market rate) with remodeled kitchen, bathroom, and updated flooring. The ground-floor studio is rented on a monthly Airbnb-style basis, offering excellent flexibility for guest use, income, or owner expansion. Recent building-wide upgrades include a new roof (2021), partial exterior painting, smart locks, video doorbells, porch lighting, and Amazon-enabled garage access. The building also has a two-car tandem garage with new laundry and water heaters, plus city-approved plans for a third parking space. Exceptional location near parks, shops, dining, and tech shuttles. Whether you're an owner-occupant looking for a move-in-ready flat with income, or an investor seeking a well-maintained asset in a prime rental market, 943-945 Haight Street is a rare opportunity.
